ctx.x: So they made him the leader and so I said if that's what you want, but he was going to be boss. He had guts. He

said I'm going to be boss all the way.
And so, at the same time--I don't know Jack's first name--I mean last name, but there was a piano player named Jack, and I made a special trip to Muskogee and T remembered me coming in (inaudible), but Jack was a very fine piano player and he got sick. John Williams was playing alto and Mary Lou was piano, but Mary Lou then was just kind of going around with the band, and so, when Jack got sick and was ill several weeks, T sent him home just to straighten out and let Mary…
Did you loan him the three dollars?
